the development of a Fuzzy C-Mean clustering technique based model that automatically converts crisp data into fuzzy sets for academic performance evaluation.
the development of a Fuzzy C-Mean clustering based expert system model for academic performance evaluation of engineering students.
the use of Fuzzy Logic in student performance evaluation and allocation.

the fuzzy C-Means algorithm is a powerful tool to cluster the students into homogenous groups and to predict their academic performances in the next semester.
